                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><h2 data-id="heading-0">资深前端都在用的 9 个调试偏方</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-1">1. 技巧 1：计算属性名</h3>
<p>不要这样写 ❌ ：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> user = { <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"Alice"</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">age</span>: <span class="hljs-number">30</span> };
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> product = { <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-number">123</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">price</span>: <span class="hljs-number">49.99</span> };

<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"user"</span>, user);
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"product"</span>, product);
</code></pre>
<p>现在这样写 ✅ ：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>({ user, product });
</code></pre>
<p>使用 ES6 简写对象语法会将你的变量包装在一个对象中，这样你可以在控制台中立即看到变量名和它的值。当你有 20 个日志时，不用再猜测哪个日志对应哪个变量。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/3d31973c727a4ea9a1f31ddeae021b8d~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5Ya05769:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1779939080&amp;x-signature=tlqP2Pm7e4MPXqvqgnTJbpXefb0%3D" alt="console.log 输出示例" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">2. 技巧 2：console.table()</h3>
<p>当你处理对象数组时，<code>console.log</code> 几乎毫无用处。</p>
<p>试试这个 ✅：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> users = [
  { <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"Alice"</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">age</span>: <span class="hljs-number">30</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">role</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"Admin"</span> },
  { <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"Bob"</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">age</span>: <span class="hljs-number">25</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">role</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"User"</span> },
  { <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"Charlie"</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">age</span>: <span class="hljs-number">35</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">role</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"Moderator"</span> },
];

<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">table</span>(users);
</code></pre>
<p>这会在浏览器控制台中渲染一个漂亮的、可排序的表格。</p>
<p>你可以点击列标题进行排序，它比嵌套对象更易读。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/59d6a7a82db94f4ca60cb5498e464d79~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5Ya05769:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1779939080&amp;x-signature=oL6Z%2F%2BDEATaJjCqjlxO28kiq8cg%3D" alt="console.table 输出示例" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-3">3. 技巧 3：console.trace()</h3>
<p>当你发现一个函数被多处调用，却不知道具体执行路径时：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">processPayment</span>(<span class="hljs-params">amount</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">innerFn</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">trace</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"Payment processing started"</span>);
  }

  <span class="hljs-title function_">innerFn</span>();
}

<span class="hljs-title function_">processPayment</span>(<span class="hljs-number">20</span>);
</code></pre>
<p><code>console.trace()</code> 会打印完整的调用堆栈，向你展示代码到达该点的确切路径。</p>
<p>当调试一个可能从 5 个不同地方调用的函数时，这很有用。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/9b653effc18843e797ef021d77e23211~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5Ya05769:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1779939080&amp;x-signature=UtcyYwBM4%2FvFnzb2bKm2cGy8%2BLE%3D" alt="console.trace 输出示例" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-4">4. 技巧 4：条件断点 console.assert()</h3>
<p>不要这样写 ❌ ：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (user.<span class="hljs-property">age</span> &lt; <span class="hljs-number">18</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"Underage user detected!"</span>);
}
</code></pre>
<p>现在这样写 ✅ ：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">assert</span>(user.<span class="hljs-property">age</span> &gt;= <span class="hljs-number">18</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"Underage user detected!"</span>, user);
</code></pre>
<p>只有当断言失败（条件为 false）时，它才会记录日志。</p>
<p>代码更简洁，控制台噪音更少，而且它会自动包含实际数据。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/3580339142b9430fabb32a1ff213ba5e~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5Ya05769:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1779939080&amp;x-signature=PgIIIqIuM9H8Yct08bwL945a4dA%3D" alt="console.assert 输出示例" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-5">5. 技巧 5：性能监控器 console.time()</h3>
<p>想知道操作花了多少时间，这样写：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">time</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"API Call"</span>);

<span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"https://api.example.com/data"</span>)
  .<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">response</span>) =&gt;</span> response.<span class="hljs-title function_">json</span>())
  .<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">data</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">timeEnd</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"API Call"</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> data;
  });

<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">timeEnd</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"API Call"</span>);
</code></pre>
<p>这能告诉你 <code>console.time()</code> 和 <code>console.timeEnd()</code> 之间经过了多少毫秒。我经常用它来比较不同的实现或寻找性能瓶颈。</p>
<p><strong>输出：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-plaintext" lang="plaintext">API Call: 342.87ms
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">6. 技巧 6：样式化日志</h3>
<p>让你重要的日志无法被忽视：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"%c CRITICAL ERROR"</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"color: red; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; background: yellow; padding: 10px;"</span>);
</code></pre>
<p>你可以使用 <code>%c</code> 为控制台日志添加 CSS 样式。这非常适合：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>需要立即关注的错误状态</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>开发中的成功消息</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>分隔复杂的调试输出</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/ced7115537304c61a0e540c47b6aefe5~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5Ya05769:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1779939080&amp;x-signature=YoWyUEWT%2FjiaMszmNHdgaPqxO0c%3D" alt="样式化控制台输出示例" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-7">7. 技巧 7：分组整理 console.group()</h3>
<p>调试信息太多太乱？你可以将它们分组：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">group</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"User Authentication"</span>);
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"Checking credentials..."</span>);
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"Token:"</span>, token);
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"Validating..."</span>);
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">groupEnd</span>();

<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">group</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"API Response"</span>);
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"Status:"</span>, response.<span class="hljs-property">status</span>);
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"Data:"</span>, response.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>);
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">groupEnd</span>();
</code></pre>
<p>这会在控制台中创建可折叠的分组，让你在大量调试输出中导航变得更加容易。</p>
<p>如果希望分组默认收起，可以使用 <code>console.groupCollapsed()</code>。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/8874c1584bbc45e98c766e2e649ddd62~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5Ya05769:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1779939080&amp;x-signature=YOsT8XUbVdJLF7htd7gAyuRV8i0%3D" alt="console.group 输出示例" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-8">8. 技巧 8：对象深度探索 console.dir()</h3>
<p>对于 DOM 元素或具有特殊属性的对象：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> element = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"#myButton"</span>);

<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(element); <span class="hljs-comment">// 显示 HTML 结构</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">dir</span>(element); <span class="hljs-comment">// 显示对象的属性和方法</span>
</code></pre>
<p><code>console.dir()</code> 显示对象属性的交互式列表，</p>
<p>当你想要检查方法和属性而不是 HTML 结构时，这特别适用于 DOM 元素。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/eed637ea09244cd9b5ea5de0a07e9af4~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5Ya05769:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1779939080&amp;x-signature=zrgwXPEv797JrvBUDQc1OxPlkdU%3D" alt="console.dir 输出示例" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-9">9. 技巧 9：日志级别</h3>
<p>别再所有事情都用 <code>console.log()</code>。</p>
<p>JavaScript 给你不同的日志级别是有原因的：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"Regular information"</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 普通信息</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">info</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"ℹ️ User logged in"</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 信息提示</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">warn</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"⚠️ API rate limit at 80%"</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 警告</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">error</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"❌ Payment failed"</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 错误</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">debug</span>(<span class="hljs-string">" Variable state:"</span>, x); <span class="hljs-comment">// 调试信息</span>
</code></pre>
<p>现代浏览器的 DevTools 允许你按日志级别过滤。</p>
<p>在生产环境调试时，你可以隐藏所有的 <code>console.log</code> 和 <code>console.debug</code> 语句，只查看警告和错误。</p>
<p>这样能让关键问题在大量的调试输出中不会被忽略。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-10">最后</h3>
<p><strong>正确的调试技巧可以为你节省数小时的试错时间。</strong></p>
<p>掌握这些工具，你将减少添加日志的时间，增加实际修复 bug 的时间。</p>
